items.zh: 背单词首页新增「已学词」入口,可按熟练度、词书、易错词和学习日期查看学过的单词,也能按英文开头搜索。
items.en: The wordbook home has a Learned Words page: browse what you have learned by level, book, weak words and date, or search by the start of a word.

items.zh: 点一个已学的词就能打开它的词卡。
items.en: Tap any learned word to open its word card.

items.zh: 新增「自由复习」:随时挑一批学过的词,用翻卡、快速回忆、选择题或拼写再练一遍。
items.en: New free review: pick a batch of learned words any time and practice them with flashcards, quick recall, multiple choice or spelling.

items.zh: 自由复习不占用每日复习上限,也不影响连续达标。
items.en: Free review does not use up your daily review limit and does not affect your streak.

title_zh: 已结束的房间可以重新开启

items.zh: 联机大厅现在只列出进行中的房间。
items.en: The rooms lobby now lists only rooms that are still open.

items.zh: 新增「已结束的房间」页,可以回看历史消息和学习小结。
items.en: A new Ended Rooms page lets you look back at past messages and the learning summary.

items.zh: 房主可以重新开启已结束的房间,成员保持不变,房间码会更新。
items.en: The host can reopen an ended room: members stay the same and the room gets a new code.

title_zh: 智能体:角色、带我学和记忆
title_en: Agents: personas, tutor mode and memory

items.zh: 在 AI 对话里可以选择不同的角色,也可以创建和编辑自己的角色。
items.en: Choose a different persona in AI chat, or create and edit your own.

items.zh: 新增「带我学」:AI 出题、点评并给出总结,可以打字或用语音回答。
items.en: New Teach Me mode: the AI asks questions, gives feedback and a summary, and you can answer by typing or by voice.

items.zh: 在设置里可以查看、整理和清除 AI 对你的记忆。
items.en: In Settings you can view, tidy up and clear what the AI remembers about you.

items.zh: 联机房间里可以用 @ai 呼叫智能体,房间导师也能带大家一起练习。
items.en: In online rooms you can call an agent with @ai, and a room tutor can guide everyone through practice.

items.zh: 背单词的单词卡新增英文释义,默认只显示英文,点卡片右上角的「中」可临时查看中文。
items.en: Word cards in the wordbook now have English definitions, shown by default; tap the small Chinese switch on the card to see Chinese for that card.

items.zh: 可以在「每日目标」里选择释义显示:中英文、仅中文或仅英文。
items.en: In Daily Goals you can choose how definitions are shown: Chinese and English, Chinese only or English only.

items.zh: 选中英文单词或短语后,底部会出现「查词、朗读、加入生词本」操作条。
items.en: Select an English word or phrase and a bar appears at the bottom with Look up, Read aloud and Add to wordbook.

items.zh: 查词先查本地词典,命中立刻显示并支持 went 查到 go 这样的词形变化,查不到再交给 AI。
items.en: Lookups check the built-in dictionary first, including word forms such as went to go, and fall back to the AI only when nothing is found.

items.zh: 新增「跟读库」:上传自己的音视频,或粘贴视频链接导入。
items.en: New shadowing library: upload your own audio or video, or paste a video link to import it.

items.zh: 逐句播放,可以单句循环、调整语速,并录音跟读、查看评分。
items.en: Play sentence by sentence, loop a single sentence, change the speed, then record yourself and see your score.

items.zh: 每一句都可以显示中文译文,也可以让 AI 分析这一句。
items.en: Show a Chinese translation for any sentence, or ask the AI to analyse it.

items.zh: 跟读库有独立的底部标签和毛玻璃界面,并新增外观设置:跟随系统、浅色或深色。
items.en: The library has its own bottom tab and a frosted-glass look, and there is a new appearance setting: follow the system, light or dark.

title_zh: 修复 iPhone 输入框跳动
title_en: Fix: page jumping on iPhone inputs

items.zh: 修复 iPhone Safari 里点开对话或联机输入框后页面跳到顶部、要点空白处才能恢复的问题。
items.en: Fixed the page jumping to the top in iPhone Safari after tapping the chat or room message box, which needed a tap elsewhere to recover.

title_zh: 对话里的跟读弹窗和更准的句子时间
title_en: Shadowing window in chat and more accurate sentence timing

items.zh: 在对话、查词等处点「跟读」,会在原地弹出跟读窗口,不再跳到练习页。
items.en: Tapping Shadow in chat, lookups and other places now opens a shadowing window in place instead of jumping to the practice page.

items.zh: 在跟读窗口里录音或评分时关闭,会先确认,避免误触丢失。
items.en: Closing the shadowing window while recording or scoring now asks for confirmation first.

items.zh: 跟读库的句子时间改为优先使用语音识别给出的真实时间,开头几句不再对不上。
items.en: Library sentence timing now prefers the real times from speech recognition, so the first sentences no longer drift.

items.zh: 已导入的素材可以在卡片菜单里「重新识别」,识别结果可疑时会有提示。
items.en: Imported items can be re-recognized from the card menu, and you get a notice when a result looks doubtful.

title_zh: 复习答题后的学习内容

items.zh: 复习选择题答完后,每个选项在中文下面多一行对应的英文单词,中英对照,方便辨析。
items.en: After you answer a multiple-choice review question, every option keeps its Chinese and adds its English word underneath, so you can compare them side by side.

items.zh: 答题后题目下方会出现「学习内容」:英文释义、短语和朗读,或正确单词的卡片。
items.en: After answering, a study panel appears under the question with the English definition, phrases and audio, or the card of the correct word.

items.zh: 长按某个选项里的单词就能查词、朗读或加入生词本,第一次答题后会有提示。
items.en: Press and hold the word in an option to look it up, hear it or add it to your wordbook; a hint shows after your first answer.

items.zh: 学习内容和查词卡片里新增「中文」按钮:默认只看英文释义,需要时点一下显示中文释义和短语翻译。
items.en: The study panel and the lookup card now have a 「中文」 button: English definitions by default, tap to show the Chinese meanings and phrase translations.

items.zh: 修复安卓浏览器里选中文字后点「查词/朗读/加入生词本」条会立刻消失、没有反应的问题。
items.en: Fixed the lookup bar vanishing on Android browsers when you tapped it after selecting text.

items.zh: 复习里的例句选词、听写和拼写题,答完后也会显示中文释义和学习内容,和其他题型一致。
items.en: Fill-the-sentence, dictation and spelling questions in review now show the Chinese meaning and the study panel after you answer, like the other question types.

items.zh: 跟读库新增「精选」:内置的跟读素材,不用自己上传,点「添加到我的库」就能开始跟读;内置素材不占用你的空间,除跟读评分外不消耗额度。
items.en: The shadowing library has a new 「精选」 tab of built-in material: tap 「添加到我的库」 to start without uploading. Built-in items use no storage; only shadowing assessment uses your allowance.

items.zh: 所有出现 A1~C2 的地方(对话、联机创建房间的目标水平、智能体、排位、精选库)都标注了水平含义,例如「B1 · 中级」。
items.en: Everywhere a level like A1-C2 appears (chat, target level when creating a room, agents, rank, the featured library) now says what it means, e.g. 「B1 · Intermediate」.

items.zh: 底部导航栏改成悬浮的圆角透明玻璃条,不再贴满屏幕底边,内容透过它隐约可见。
items.en: The bottom tab bar is now a floating, rounded, transparent glass pill instead of a full-width bar, with content faintly visible through it.
